nodes.label: HACS zip_release content_in_root Convention
nodes.rationale: HACS's zip_release download mode with content_in_root:false extracts the release archive straight into the plugin's own folder, so the zip's contents must sit at the top level (built from inside public/) rather than under a public/ wrapper directory.

nodes.label: CHANGELOG
nodes.rationale: Keep a Changelog format; Italian body per release with English summary for recent ones.

nodes.label: v1.9.0
nodes.rationale: Release 'funziona anche senza internet, e chiede il codice': everything loaded at startup ships with the install, PIN-gated alarm controllable from the dashboard, irrigation safety net running inside Home Assistant.

nodes.label: v1.8.1
nodes.rationale: Patch from an issue where irrigation buttons/climate row 'did not respond' with zero console errors: the tap->service path was intact, but nothing ever read its outcome.

nodes.label: v1.7.1
nodes.rationale: Observability release, not a new filter: HA 2026.9.0 re-registered Matter devices as area-less duplicates and covers silently vanished from rooms.

nodes.label: Vendored React runtime (public/vendor/ react + react-dom 18.3.1)
nodes.rationale: support.js downloaded React from unpkg.com on every load: an offline HA, a CDN-blocking network or an unpkg outage meant a blank tablet with no message. Files are byte-identical to unpkg (SHA-384 matches the SRI pinned in support.js, rechecked by a test); loaded via two <script> tags before support.js so the runtime finds window.React and skips the download; CDN kept as fallback if vendor/ is missing.

nodes.label: Vendored web fonts (Caprasimo + Figtree woff2 in public/vendor/fonts/)
nodes.rationale: Removes the Google Fonts dependency; Figtree is variable so one file per subset covers all weights including 500 that the browser used to synthesize. Verified: zero off-install requests at startup.
nodes.norm_label: vendored web fonts (caprasimo + figtree woff2 in public/vendor/fonts/)

nodes.label: Differential state push (casa:hass-states-delta)
nodes.rationale: panel.js sent a full hass.states copy every 600 ms (666 entities, ~175 KB/message) and the dashboard re-rendered for entities it doesn't show. After a first snapshot only changed entities are sent, detected by reference comparison since HA replaces an entity's object on change; no-op updates send nothing. Measured ~14 KB in 30 s. Full snapshot resent every 5 minutes and on iframe reload as safety net.

nodes.label: Full snapshot resync (every 5 min and on iframe reload)
nodes.rationale: Safety net for the delta protocol: guarantees eventual consistency if a delta is lost.
nodes.norm_label: full snapshot resync (every 5 min and on iframe reload)

nodes.label: Alarm PIN pad (code_format keypad / password field)
nodes.rationale: Panels declaring code_format previously only showed 'use the HA app'. Numeric keypad (64 px keys) for code_format: number, password field otherwise; stays open until HA answers, clears digits and says 'Codice non accettato' on rejection. Code never stored, logged in Ultime azioni, nor included in Copia diagnostica.
nodes.norm_label: alarm pin pad (code_format keypad / password field)

nodes.label: Irrigation safety close blueprint
nodes.rationale: Covers the limit declared in 1.8.1: with zero open dashboards the timed close never fired. Runs inside HA, closes valves open beyond a max time (default 20 min) whoever opened them, plus valves still open at HA restart; handles switch.* and valve.*; validated on a real install.

nodes.label: Vendored hls.js 1.7.4 (vendor/hls.light.min.js)
nodes.rationale: The second live-view layer was written but always inactive; Chrome/Android/companion-app users saw only fast stills. Loaded lazily only when a camera live view opens on a browser without native HLS. Identical to the npm package (sha512 registry integrity verified). Decision made easy once React was recognized as already a third-party runtime dependency.

nodes.label: Diagnostica -> Ambiente -> 'Runtime React' row
nodes.rationale: Shows 'incluso nella dashboard' or 'da CDN (unpkg) — vendor/ mancante, serve internet' so tablet users can see which React copy ran.

nodes.label: Tests and CI (20 node --test tests, no dependencies)
nodes.rationale: Covers section order, visibility, smart plugs, Matter duplicates, discoverRooms discard reasons, vendor/ file integrity, no external resources in pages, same keys in it.js/en.js, VERSION aligned with CHANGELOG.
nodes.norm_label: tests and ci (20 node --test tests, no dependencies)

nodes.label: call() single service-call choke point with outcome ring buffer
nodes.rationale: call() was fire-and-forget silent; now every service call records ok/error/timeout and duration in a session ring buffer (last 20). Never rejects its promise so it stays safe to call without await.
nodes.norm_label: call() single service-call choke point with outcome ring buffer

nodes.label: Live Dashboard README

nodes.description: Italian translation of README.md, same structure and content.

nodes.label: panel_custom integration
nodes.rationale: The dashboard is one page in its own panel_custom panel, not a Lovelace dashboard or card; snapshot/stream URLs are HA-signed and same-origin with the panel, which is why panel_custom is the only supported install method.

nodes.label: panel name must be <folder>-panel
nodes.rationale: The panel element registers itself under <folder>-panel derived from the folder it runs from; under HACS this is always live_dashboard-panel. A mismatch loads a blank/black panel, now reported on-page and via console.error.

nodes.label: Landscape wall-tablet design target (1280x800)
nodes.rationale: Fixed ~1200x800 landscape tablet is a deliberate constraint; columns size to content and scroll internally rather than stretch. Mobile page is complete but secondary.

nodes.label: No npm, no build step (plain ES modules)
nodes.rationale: Everything is plain HTML/CSS/JS loaded as ES modules from config/www/.
nodes.norm_label: no npm, no build step (plain es modules)

nodes.label: No internet access needed to run (v1.9.0)
nodes.rationale: A local-only Home Assistant must still draw the dashboard, so the runtime library ships in public/vendor/ instead of a CDN; Diagnostica -> Environment -> 'React runtime' shows which copy ran.
nodes.norm_label: no internet access needed to run (v1.9.0)

nodes.label: Vendored React 18.3.1 runtime (public/vendor/)
nodes.rationale: Shipped locally instead of fetched from a CDN so the dashboard starts without internet.

nodes.label: Vendored web fonts (Caprasimo, Figtree) in public/vendor/
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: fonts ship with the dashboard instead of Google Fonts, so a local-only Home Assistant renders with the designed typography and makes no external requests.
nodes.norm_label: vendored web fonts (caprasimo, figtree) in public/vendor/

nodes.label: HACS installation (config/www/community/live_dashboard/)
nodes.rationale: Recommended: update notifications and one-click updates. HACS updates files only, never configuration.yaml.

nodes.label: Manual installation (copy public/ to config/www/<folder>/)
nodes.rationale: Allows side-by-side copies (casa/casa2); that pattern does not apply to HACS.

nodes.label: module_url ?v= cache-busting
nodes.rationale: /local/ is served with long cache headers and browsers cache ES modules aggressively, so the ?v= query must be bumped on each update.

nodes.label: Home Assistant restart required for panel_custom
nodes.rationale: panel_custom entries are registered at startup and are not hot-reloadable.
nodes.norm_label: home assistant restart required for panel_custom

nodes.label: User config live_dashboard_config.js (config/www/)
nodes.rationale: Lives outside the HACS-managed folder so updates never overwrite it; lookup order: config/www/live_dashboard_config.js, then community/live_dashboard/config.js, then config.js next to panel.js.

nodes.label: Auto-discovery from HA area/device/entity registries
nodes.rationale: With no config, up to 12 areas become room tiles plus person.*, first weather.* and first alarm_control_panel.*; house-mode, Energy, Irrigation and Vehicle stay opt-in because they cannot be guessed. Result is only as good as area assignments.

nodes.label: Settings panel (gear icon, v1.5.0)
nodes.rationale: Per-user visibility/order saved in HA account storage (frontend/user_data); config.js still alone resolves sensor roles. Overrides show a 'differs from config.js' pill; 'Export as config.js' produces a paste-ready block. Hides/reorders only, does not compose layouts.

nodes.label: Home section order (sections.order, v1.7.0)
nodes.rationale: One order shared by desktop and mobile so tablet and phone never disagree.

nodes.label: Energy view (Fotovoltaico)
nodes.rationale: Reads HA Energy dashboard prefs automatically; else best-effort guess from device_class energy + total_increasing sensors; config.energy only overrides. Sensors requested by role, not brand.

nodes.label: Energy sensor roles (production, gridImport, gridExport, productionToday, ...)
nodes.norm_label: energy sensor roles (production, gridimport, gridexport, productiontoday, ...)

nodes.label: Derived house consumption formula
nodes.rationale: consumption = production + gridImport - gridExport + batteryDischarge - batteryCharge, only when all three inputs resolve; otherwise an honest '—'. Derived values are labeled 'calculated' so they are never mistaken for a measured sensor.

nodes.label: Battery power sign toggle (Settings -> Energy)
nodes.rationale: No universal sign convention across integrations; defaults to positive = charging, with live preview and a warning when derived consumption is persistently negative.

nodes.label: Fotovoltaico double ring (consumption outer, production inner)
nodes.rationale: Replaces the older single ring that compared production vs grid import (not a real quantity); each ring now sums to a real total. Autoconsumo is shared by both rings, same color, derived as production - gridExport or consumption - gridImport. Falls back to single ring without an export sensor.
nodes.norm_label: fotovoltaico double ring (consumption outer, production inner)

nodes.label: Irrigation view (zones: moisture + valve or buttons)
nodes.rationale: Agronomic math (ET0/ETc, deficit) is deliberately not part of the project; it depends on the user's own station and soil data.
nodes.norm_label: irrigation view (zones: moisture + valve or buttons)

nodes.label: Valve timed close via frontend/user_data deadline
nodes.rationale: Deadline saved to frontend/user_data (or localStorage) and checked every 15s by any open client, so reloading/closing the starting tab does not leave the valve open; but with zero dashboards open nothing closes it.
nodes.norm_label: valve timed close via frontend/user_data deadline

nodes.label: irrigation_safety_close.yaml automation blueprint (v1.9.0)
nodes.rationale: HA-side safety net: closes any selected valve open longer than a maximum (default 20 min), whoever opened it, plus any still open at HA restart; covers the zero-open-dashboards case. Set the maximum a bit above the longest durations entry.

nodes.label: One-click blueprint import (my.home-assistant.io)
nodes.rationale: my.home-assistant.io blueprint_import redirect, or copy to config/blueprints/automation/live_dashboard/ and create an automation picking the same valve entities.

nodes.label: Weather station (config.weatherStation)
nodes.rationale: Local station sensors override the weather entity as more accurate/local; reuses irrigation.weather sensors automatically.

nodes.label: Vehicle (config.vehicle)
nodes.rationale: No HA domain standardizes car telemetry, so explicit field mapping; used with Mercedes mbapi2020.

nodes.label: Appliances (config.appliances)
nodes.rationale: Running state matters more than on/off; room resolved from the status entity's area; a powerSwitch 'on' is not treated as running.

nodes.label: Smart plug three-state switch (off/active/running, v1.5.4)
nodes.rationale: Uses a device_class power sensor on the same device; threshold default 3 W, adjustable in Settings -> Energia.

nodes.label: Cameras (auto-discovered camera.*)
nodes.rationale: Previews not video: entity_picture snapshots every snapshotInterval (10s), paused when hidden. Surveillance tab only with 2+ cameras; 3 columns above gridTab (6).

nodes.label: Layered camera live view (v1.5.4)
nodes.rationale: Tap tries in order: native HLS, hls.js, fast still polling; detail view closes after 2 minutes.

nodes.label: Native HLS via HA stream integration (layer 1)
nodes.norm_label: native hls via ha stream integration (layer 1)

nodes.label: hls.js 1.7.4 (vendored, layer 2, v1.9.0)
nodes.rationale: Shipped in public/vendor/ and loaded lazily only when a camera is opened (~390 KB), for Chrome/Firefox/Android/companion apps without native HLS. Diagnostics shows which layer is in use.

nodes.label: Fast still-image polling fallback (layer 3)
nodes.rationale: 2-3 fps from entity_picture, labeled 'preview refreshing' not 'live'; works on any camera/platform.

nodes.label: Demo mode (?demo, file://)
nodes.rationale: Lets anyone try the dashboard with no Home Assistant; falls back automatically from file:// after a timeout, shows a DEMO badge, never calls a real service.

nodes.rationale: Rooms show what you'd act on or ask about; power-metering sensors are never pills; battery only under 20%; binary sensors only while on.

nodes.rationale: Users on tablets/companion apps have no console; Diagnostica names the config path loaded, energy sensor resolution, React runtime copy, camera live layer, with a 'Copy diagnostics' button.

nodes.label: Vendored React 18.3.1 UMD script tags
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: React ships with the dashboard instead of unpkg; plain <script> tags placed before support.js so loadReactUmd() skips its CDN fetch when window.React/ReactDOM exist. Versioned file names instead of ?v= because react@18.3.1 content never changes. Missing vendor file falls back to CDN.

nodes.label: window.CASA_REACT_SOURCE ('local'|'cdn')
nodes.rationale: Records which React runtime actually ran, surfaced in Diagnostica > Ambiente (users on tablets have no console).

nodes.label: @font-face rules (Caprasimo, Figtree) from ./vendor/fonts/
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: fonts vendored (OFL) instead of Google Fonts so the page looks the same with no internet; Figtree variable font, one file per subset.

nodes.label: bust() cache-busting helper
nodes.rationale: Reuses panel.js VERSION (?v=) so one bump busts discovery.js, config.js, i18n and backend scripts too.

nodes.label: loadScript()
nodes.rationale: Classic <script> injection instead of import(): Chrome blocks ES module fetches from file:// (demo mode).

nodes.label: CONFIG_PATHS (config.js candidate locations)
nodes.rationale: /local/live_dashboard_config.js first, outside the HACS-managed folder so updates don't wipe it; /local paths skipped outside an iframe to avoid pointless 404s.

nodes.label: loadUserConfig()
nodes.rationale: Captures config load attempts as plain data for the Diagnostica panel.

nodes.label: state.pin (PIN pad state)
nodes.rationale: The alarm code lives only in this.state.pin while the pad is open: never stored, never logged, never shown in clear.

nodes.label: _camStartStream() three-layer camera live view
nodes.rationale: Layers: native HLS <video>, then hls.js, then fast camera_proxy stills; always degrades to something moving instead of a black rectangle.

nodes.label: _ensureHlsJs()
nodes.rationale: Lazily loads ./vendor/hls.light.min.js once per session, only when a non-Safari browser opens a camera detail.

nodes.label: _boot()
nodes.rationale: Assigns discovery/be/cfg/registries/t/strings synchronously together so a hass-states re-render never sees a half-booted mix.

nodes.label: _resolveEnergyDaily()
nodes.rationale: Resolution order per role: config.js, then HA Energy prefs, then auto-discovery; captures diag data for the Diagnostica panel.

nodes.label: deriveConsumption()
nodes.rationale: Returns derived:false rather than a partial sum; prefer an absent number to a plausible wrong one.

nodes.label: call() service-call choke point
nodes.rationale: v1.8.1: every service call logged to a 20-entry ring buffer and failures surfaced as a toast; always resolves so fire-and-forget call sites stay safe.

nodes.label: _bindAttr() ref callback
nodes.rationale: src/href/points must be set from a ref callback after mount; the browser parser acts on them before JS runs.

nodes.label: alarmGuardedCall()
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: an alarm action on a code_format panel opens the PIN pad instead of being a no-op; code_arm_required only softens arming, disarm is gated on code_format alone.

nodes.label: pinSubmit()
nodes.rationale: Pad stays open until HA answers; a wrong code clears the digits and shows an error next to the input.

nodes.label: Alarm PIN pad template (sc-if pinOpen)
nodes.rationale: Numeric keypad for code_format 'number', password field with system keyboard otherwise. No mount animation: a style= animation would replay on every re-render.

nodes.label: Diagnostica Recent actions template (diagActionRows / noDiagActionRows)
nodes.rationale: Negated branch exposed as its own name noDiagActionRows; two sc-if with the same expression and opposite placeholders rendered both branches (v1.8.1).

nodes.label: dash_neumo_mobile.html (phone layout)
nodes.rationale: Phone layout of the dashboard; logic mirrors dash_neumo.html method-for-method so desktop and mobile never disagree.

nodes.label: Vendored React/ReactDOM 18.3.1 <script> tags
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: React loads from ./vendor/ before support.js so the dashboard starts without internet; a missing vendor file still falls back to CDN.

nodes.label: window.CASA_REACT_SOURCE ('local'|'cdn')
nodes.rationale: Records which React copy actually ran, surfaced in Diagnostica.

nodes.label: @font-face rules for ./vendor/fonts (Caprasimo, Figtree)
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: OFL fonts shipped locally instead of Google Fonts so the page looks the same offline; Figtree variable font, one file per subset.

nodes.label: ASSET_V cache-bust version
nodes.rationale: Reuses panel.js's ?v= so one VERSION bump busts the whole script chain, not just this file.

nodes.label: loadScript()
nodes.rationale: Classic <script> injection instead of import(): Chrome blocks ES module fetches from file://, which would break demo mode.

nodes.label: CONFIG_PATHS
nodes.rationale: /local/live_dashboard_config.js first (outside HACS-managed folder so updates don't wipe it); /local candidates only tried inside the HA iframe to avoid pointless 404s.

nodes.label: Component._camStartStream()
nodes.rationale: Tiered live view: native HLS, then hls.js, then fast snapshot polling (what most Android companion-app users get).

nodes.label: Component._ensureHlsJs()
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: lazy-loads ./vendor/hls.light.min.js once (memoised promise) only when native HLS is unavailable.

nodes.label: Component.deriveConsumption()
nodes.rationale: House consumption derived as production + import - export + battery term when no consumption sensor is configured.

nodes.label: Component.batterySignVerdict()
nodes.rationale: Flags a likely inverted battery sign convention when >=5 samples over 3 min mostly yield negative derived consumption.

nodes.label: Component.call()
nodes.rationale: v1.8.1: every service call is logged (entity+service, never data) to the Recent actions log and failures raise a toast — no silent failures.

nodes.label: alarmGuardedCall()
nodes.rationale: v1.9.0: a code-gated alarm action opens the PIN pad instead of doing nothing; code lives only in state.pin, never stored, logged or shown.

nodes.label: pinSubmit()
nodes.rationale: Pad stays open until HA answers; a wrong code clears digits and shows the error next to the pad, on top of call()'s toast.

nodes.label: pinKeys (numeric keypad model)
nodes.rationale: Keypad only for code_format 'number'; other formats get a password field with the system keyboard.

nodes.label: Recent actions Diagnostica template (diagActionRows / noDiagActionRows)
nodes.rationale: Negated branch exposed as its own name noDiagActionRows to avoid duplicate sc-if rendering both branches.
